findings.summary: Declining every required-text fold whose lowering emits statements lost pure helpers that pin a shared result; the fold declines only an impure expression (`EvaluationOrder.isPureExpression`) that emits statements, and the comment states the real hazard (a committed probe keeps its statements and the position may ask again).
The setter-only comment described history; it states the fact, and a test pins that such a property maps as data and refuses where its record is stored.
